author: @ruth4489
text: Praise Jesus!!! Pres Trump had to reassure most Americans that despite being out there for a month, we are going to finish up what we started. So you are going to see a ratcheting up of this war because he wants to ensure the few of the IRGC left and stockpiles are ELIMINATED. He is basically promising people that this is not a forever war like Iraq and Afghanistan. And he mentioned the Hormuz. I think he is cooking something up with the Arab nations to open the Strait of Hormuz without too many other nations getting involved. I know Japan, France, Croatia, and a few others have sent ships to help with the Strait of Hormuz. God help the Iranians being cut off from the outside world. If we bomb them to the stone Age, we will try to help them rebuild their nation. And the rain will come. God will send rain once Iran is Liberated. It will be a sign from God. God keep Crown Prince Reza safe and I know he is working behind the scenes trying to come up with a new government for Iran. I think Trump wants it to be a surprise because he doesnt want the IRGC proxies here in America to harm them. Trump looks tired, he needs to sleep tonight and prepare for Good Friday service and Easter Sunday. May the Lord renew him.
